source.cite: P. S. Metkar, "Experimental and Kinetic Modeling Studies of Selective Catalytic Reduction of NOx with NH3 on Fe- and Cu-Zeolite Monolithic Catalysts", PhD dissertation, University of Houston, 2012 (advisors M. P. Harold and V. Balakotaiah).
source.conditions: Steady state after about 25 min per point, 1000 sccm total in Ar, GHSV about 57,000 1/h (thesis p. 333 and ch. 9). Pretreated at 500 C in 5% O2. FTIR analyzer (MKS MultiGas 2030).

reactor: isothermal plug flow, ideal (no mass-transfer limits)

fe_zsm5.form: washcoated cordierite monolith, 400 cpsi, 2 cm long, 34 channels
